evidence: ref27/System/Applications/Weather.app/Contents/Info.plist via bifrost pc ref extract (URL scheme weather, user activities WeatherIntent; NSLocationUsageDescription for local weather and notifications near you)

springboard/apps/weather-desktop/src/ and springboard/src/shell/weather/ (data.rs forecast query, glyph.rs)

features.apple: Source list of saved places, each with a live temperature and condition
features.bifrost: springboard/apps/weather-desktop/src/weather.rs:377 (sidebar, the sky glyph drawn over the row)
features.note: Each sidebar row shows the place's sky glyph, its sky in words and its last known temperature. Not yet verified on Midget.
features.wire: Verify the two-line rows, temperature and sky glyph on Midget.

features.apple: Search field finds a city and adds it to the list
features.note: Sidebar search opens the Locations page with a focused field; results add a place.

features.apple: Delete from the list (Edit > Delete, swipe, context menu)
features.bifrost: springboard/apps/weather-desktop/src/weather.rs:1149 (context_items, the sidebar secondary-click menu with Remove); springboard/apps/weather-desktop/src/weather.rs:1235 (the Delete key)
features.note: Delete or Backspace removes the selected place from the main page, and the sidebar secondary-click menu offers Remove. Not yet verified on Midget.
features.wire: Verify the Delete key and the sidebar context menu on Midget.

features.apple: Drag rows to reorder the list
features.bifrost: springboard/apps/weather-desktop/src/weather.rs:1119 (reorder_places, a drag test at weather.rs:2131); springboard/apps/weather-desktop/src/insights.rs (move_item, follow_selection, drop_index)
features.note: Dragging a sidebar row moves the place, keeps the same place selected and saves the order; the moves are tested headless in insights::tests. Not yet verified on Midget.
features.wire: Verify the sidebar drag on Midget; there is no keyboard reordering and no drag on the Locations page.

features.apple: First entry follows the device location and asks for permission (NSLocationUsageDescription)
features.note: The shell gives apps no location service yet; the authorization is fixed at NotDetermined and the Locations note says so.
features.wire: When the shell exposes a location service, replace the LOCATION constant (weather.rs:142) by a request through bifrost_app::controls::location, insert a My Location place first and refresh it on movement; insights::location_note (insights.rs:167) already words the states.

features.apple: Air Quality index card with level and main pollutant
features.note: The card names the main pollutant, the one furthest over its European Good limit, with its concentration, the index band and the advice for the band. The model is tested headless in springboard/tests/parity_app-weather.rs. Not yet verified on Midget.
features.wire: Verify the taller card on Midget against the reference card.

features.apple: Today's high against the average high for the date
features.note: The Averages tile shows the difference between today's high and the ten-year mean high of this date from the archive, with a word for it. The kit statistics model (springboard/ui/src/weather_stats.rs) is not used by the app. Not yet verified on Midget.
features.wire: Verify the tile on Midget; move the mean onto weather_stats only if the app needs its percentiles.

features.apple: Interactive temperature line over the day
features.note: Line with area fill, labelled axis and times.

features.apple: Precipitation, Temperature and Air Quality map overlays with a Map button in the toolbar
features.note: The Map card draws a latitude and longitude grid around the place with a centre mark and a scale bar; the grid is tested headless in insights::tests. Gap: no base map tiles, no Precipitation, Temperature or Air Quality overlays and no layer switch.
features.wire: Use bifrost-maps (springboard/apps/maps-desktop tiles, cache, source) to draw base tiles under the card and add radar overlay tiles from a configurable raster layer URL with a layer switch (Precipitation, Temperature, Air Quality) in the toolbar.

features.apple: Alert banner with region and threat level, full alert text
features.note: Audit 2026-10-13: kit model ui/src/weather_alert.rs (host tests) already provides this; the app does not use it yet.
features.wire: Choose an alert feed in data.rs, fill bifrost_ui::weather_alert::WeatherAlert, restore the banner.

features.apple: Notifications for severe weather, precipitation starting, rain tomorrow (per-location setting)
features.note: Per place, behind the Notify switch: rain starting within the hour, and rain tomorrow at 60 percent or more, once a day. Severe weather alerts are not posted because there is no alert feed. Not yet verified on Midget.
features.wire: Alert notifications need an alert feed (see Severe weather alerts). Verify both notice kinds on Midget.

features.apple: Weather > Settings: Temperature Units Celsius or Fahrenheit, with wind and distance following
features.note: C and F switch; wind and map scale follow it.

features.apple: Updates in the background and keeps the last forecast offline
features.note: 15-minute refresh, disk cache, offline state and retry when the network path returns (services.rs:51).

features.apple: Weather widgets for desktop and Notification Centre
features.note: Current-conditions timeline entries pushed to the shell.

features.apple: Weather data attribution link
features.note: Footer credits the data service with its terms link.

features.apple: weather: URL scheme, user activities WeatherIntent and handoff
features.note: weather:// links select a saved place or look a name up and add it, and the lat and lon form adds a position. The SDK has no user activity or handoff service, so the WeatherIntent activity is not registered. Not yet verified on Midget.
features.wire: Register the user activity and handoff when the SDK has a user-activity service.

features.apple: Share forecast, Weather intent for assistants and shortcuts
features.note: The Share button sends the selected place's summary to the share menu. A Current Weather intent, a shortcut with no parameters, answers with that summary. Not yet verified on Midget.
features.wire: Verify the intent in Search and Shortcuts on Midget; the weather.* control methods already exist.
